TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A dense pile of dozens of antique alarm clocks stacked atop one another, every face heavily rusted, corroded, and weathered with peeling dials. The largest clock in the foreground shows bent hands and faded numerals against a decayed cream face; the jumbled heap fills the entire frame in warm brown and rust tones, evoking abandoned or salvaged timepieces.
TEXT: NONE
